verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਚਰਖਾ ਅਠਖੰਭੀਆ ਦੁਹਿ ਲਠੀ ਦੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੰਝੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: jiau charakhaa aThakha(n)bheeaa dhuh laThee dhe ma(n)jh ma(n)jheroo|

en.bdb: The eight board spinningwheel moves between two upright posts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਸਿਰ ਧਰਿ ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਰ ਗਿਰਦਾਨ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਖਫੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: dhui sir dhar dhuh khu(n)dd vich sir giradhaan firai lakhaferoo|

en.bdb: Both ends of its axle are thrust in the holes in the middle of two post and on the force of its neck the wheel is turned innumerable times.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਇੜੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਲ੍ਹ ਵਟਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਟ ਘੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: baiR pai paleTeeaai maalh vaTai paiaa ghaT gheroo|

en.bdb: The two sides are secured by a fastening cord and a string belt encircles the wheel and the spindle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੁ ਚਰਮਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰਕਲਾ ਕਤਨਿ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਚਿੜੀਆਂ ਹੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: dhuh charamakh vich trakalaa katan kuReeaa(n) chiReeaa(n) heroo|

en.bdb: Two pieces of leather hold the spindle around which the girls spin sitting in groups.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿੰਞਣਿ ਬਹਿ ਉਠ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਉਡਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: tira(n)n(j)n beh uTh jaa(n)dheeaa(n) jiau birakhahu udd jaan pa(n)kheroo|

en.bdb: Sometimes they would suddenly stop spinning and leave as birds fly from the tree (the double-minded person is also like these girls or birds and changes his mind abruptly).

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੂ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਗੇਰੂ।
verses.translit_en: oR nibaahoo naa theeaai kachaa ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa geroo|

en.bdb: Ochre colour which is temporary one, does not give company up to the last i.e. it fades away after sometime.
The double-minded person (also) is like a moving shadow which does not stick to one place
